**Remedio: correction beats visibility. Find it, fix it, prove it — at machine speed.**

Remedio is a configuration-focused device hardening and autonomous remediation offering that finds, fixes, and verifies security misconfigurations, unpatched vulnerabilities, unauthorized applications, and unmanaged AI tools across agency endpoints and servers, wherever they run — on premises, remote, or in the cloud. Hardening continues off-network, indefinitely.

Remedio closes the loop between detection and correction by applying policy-controlled, automated fixes and giving administrators an instant, auditable rollback path for every change. This lets government security teams enforce baselines like DISA STIG, NIST 800-53, and CIS Benchmarks continuously — not just at audit time — while reducing the manual workload historically required to close configuration and compliance gaps at scale.

**Core capabilities**

1. **Remedio Baseline — configuration hardening.** Establishes and continuously enforces secure configuration baselines (Golden Images) across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints and servers, automatically correcting drift as it occurs.
2. **Remedio Fortify — vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation.** Identifies and prioritizes vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, then applies safe, automated remediation at scale to reduce patch and hardening backlogs.
3. **Remedio Assure — continuous compliance.** Continuously validates configuration and remediation state against required control frameworks and agency-specific policy, maintaining audit-ready evidence and full traceability for oversight and reporting.
4. **Remedio Gate — application control.** Discovers and controls installed software, scripts, and services, blocking unauthorized or risky applications, browser plugins, and dev-tool extensions before they create exposure.
5. **Remedio AI Govern — shadow AI governance.** Discovers and governs AI tools, models, agents, and connected integrations in use across the environment, bringing shadow AI into visibility and enforcing approved-use policy and access controls.

**How it works**

Each Remedio capability operates on a continuous cycle: **Review** (aggregate device state against secure baselines), **Reveal** (surface misconfigurations, identity gaps, and shadow AI usage), **Reassess** (ongoing validation against baselines and compliance mandates), **Remediate** (apply policy-controlled fixes, closing findings as they are detected rather than waiting on manual ticket cycles), and **Revert** (instant rollback of any change if conditions require). The cycle runs on the device itself, so scanning and remediation continue while a device is off the network, and findings upload when it reconnects. Every remediation action is logged for audit and reporting purposes, and the platform includes built-in ROI reporting to quantify time saved, risk reduced, and compliance gains.

Live evidence: [Trust Center](https://trust.remedio.io) · [Secure Configuration Guide](https://trust.remedio.io/scg) · [Certification progress](https://trust.remedio.io/progress) · [remedio.io](https://remedio.io)

ROSALIND is a multi-tenant SaaS solution for bioinformatics analyses, COVID diagnostic monitoring, knowledge management, and scientific collaboration. As a cloud-based software platform, ROSALIND provides a web interface for scientists and researchers to securely analyze and interpret datasets. Rosalind provides two web-based solutions, ROSALIND DxM and ROSALIND Research. Both operate in a visual manner and do not require command-line programming, cloud infrastructure setup, or bioinformatics pipeline development.

- ROSALIND DxM provides real-time SARS-CoV-2 variant surveillance and diagnostic monitoring incorporating international viral sequence data. DxM also includes a comprehensive BioBank of SARS-CoV-2 specimens with sample tracking and workflow management for test panel creation, panel blinding, and results submission across participating labs and organizations.
- ROSALIND Research provides visual analysis, interpretation, and cloud-based data sharing of genomic datasets produced with Next Generation Sequencing (NGS), NanoString instruments, and other multi-omic methods. ROSALIND Research features analysis pipelines for gene expression and gene regulation studies, including Single-Cell RNA-seq, bulk RNA-seq, miRNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, and Proteomics.

Rosalind uses knowledge graphs to securely store institutional data as searchable libraries while enabling permissions-based data sharing between authorized users and across institutions.

Through secure, web-based applications called I2Apps, Gobo automates routine engineering and operations tasks while maintaining strict human-in-the-loop control, auditability, and governance. As a vendor-agnostic platform, Gobo integrates seamlessly with existing systems and data environments, empowering federal agencies to modernize their operations while avoiding costly vendor lock-in.

To support diverse agency missions, Gobo delivers core capabilities across three key operational areas:
AI-Enabled Cognitive Automation: Gobo applies semantic intelligence to help agencies empower personnel to automate complex, data-intensive tasks at scale. As a prime example of this capability, Gobo modernizes public comment analysis and regulatory review management. Gobo streamlines complex migrations with Service Transition Management, facilitating structured transition planning and tracking for critical federal mandates such as the IPv6 transition. This is supported by automated Configuration Management, and Capacity Planning, alongside real-time performance tracking to optimize network operations and ensure system availability.
Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) Support: To automate administrative oversight, Gobo streamlines GSA EIS service management, allowing agencies to monitor how well telecommunications service providers meet promised service levels. The platform provides precision Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) and Invoice Management to track line items, automate invoice reconciliation, and facilitate dispute resolution. This capability operates alongside continuous SLA and Service Inventory Management to track the full lifecycle of agency IT assets and recover service provider credits.

SentinelOne leverages advanced machine learning algorithms and behavioral AI to analyze and automatically contextualize endpoint data collected across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Cloud Workloads. Data is contextualized and correlated into our patented Storylines technology, which accelerates triage and reduces mean time to detect/respond. Data is organized into a cohesive threat narrative which allows analysts to easily identify threat-related events as well as pivot and hunt to scope threat tactics, techniques, and impact. This gives our customers the ability to quickly stop ransomware and cyber attacks at machine speed with 1-click automated remediation and rollback of malicious activities and changes. Additionally, SentinelOne offers world-class managed detection and response (MDR), digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), and threat hunting services. Our MDR service not only augments security teams by triaging active or suspicious alerts and mitigating and blocking threats as needed, but also keeps them informed and protected from global advanced persistent threat (APT) campaigns, novel attacker techniques, and emerging trends in cybercrime with included threat hunting services. Customers can also call on SentinelOne’s integrated DFIR team for deeper forensic analysis of an event and assistance with incident response.

Providers have real-time insights to patient CPAP therapy progress, risk profiles, and engagement metrics via Somnoware’s Care Management Console.

The CloudLCMS is a rapid authoring learning content management platform. The CloudLCMS produces fully 508 compliant eLearning courses that are able to be exported in SCORM 1.2, 2004, xAPI and HTML. Clarity, hosted by stackArmor, offers U.S. government agencies a secure and scalable Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) solution to make critical decisions with confidence. product: Contract Management Planning and Surveillance System
description:
COMPASS is a contract execution management system designed for the Department of Defense (DoD) customers to manage contract lifecycles from award to completion. The system is categorized as Moderate (M) under the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) security categorization, aligning with the FedRAMP Moderate baseline for cloud services. COMPASS is hosted on Microsoft Azure Government, a platform-as-a-service (PaaS) environment, which holds a FedRAMP High Provisional Authority to Operate (P-ATO) from the Joint Authorization Board (JAB).

System Overview
COMPASS provides DoD customers with tools to track, document, and store contract files throughout the contract execution phase. Users can generate customizable reports on contract statuses and activities, with the option to receive automated email notifications based on a configurable schedule.

The application is accessed via a web interface secured with Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.2 or higher. DoD Common Access Card (CAC) authentication, utilizing X.509 certificates, ensures secure access for users. The back-end administrative access is protected through Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) and Duo Federal multi-factor authentication (MFA) using FIPS 140-2 validated hard token YubiKeys.

Infrastructure and Hosting
COMPASS is hosted on the Microsoft Azure Government cloud infrastructure, inheriting numerous FedRAMP security controls from the platform. Microsoft Azure Government manages all underlying infrastructure, ensuring compliance with stringent security requirements. The scope of inherited and partially inherited controls is outlined in Microsoft's documentation on Azure services’ audit scopes for FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG).

Security and Compliance
COMPASS implements robust security features, including logical separation of customer data within unique databases, ensuring that customers and vendors are isolated from each other’s data. Standard Technology, Inc. enforces role-based access control (RBAC) policies for both administrative staff and customer users. Azure DevOps is integrated with a commercial Azure subscription for managing the system's development, with code changes being deployed into the Azure Government environment.

The system utilizes a variety of external services for security and functionality:

Tenable Nessus Pro: Vulnerability and compliance scanning.
Microsoft Updates: OS and antivirus updates for COMPASS servers.
HCL AppScan: Dynamic code analysis.
Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP): Configuration compliance scanning.
Microsoft DevOps: Logic Apps service for creating work items triggered by security alerts.
SMTPS: Email notifications during outages and security alerts.
Naval Observatory Server: Time synchronization.
Duo Federal MFA: Provides multi-factor authentication.
Google DNSSEC: Ensures Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC).
Azure Managed Services
COMPASS leverages several managed services within Azure to enhance operational efficiency and security, including:

Azure SQL Managed Instances
Microsoft Power BI
Azure Web Apps
Microsoft Sentinel
Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Microsoft Defender for Cloud
COMPASS meets the requirements of the FedRAMP Moderate baseline and leverages the security capabilities of the Azure Government PaaS to provide DoD customers with a secure, reliable contract management platform.

Boltline is a multi-tenant manufacturing execution and operations SaaS platform. Federal customers use Boltline to manage engineering-to-production workflows, including parts, bills of materials, inventory, work plans, orders, integrations, attachments, and auditable workflow activity.

Boltline may store, process, or transmit federal customer data including user and organization records, technical product metadata, part and BOM data, work instructions, inventory and order records, files and attachments, connector payloads, integration metadata, security events, and audit logs. Depending on customer use, this data may include controlled unclassified information. Boltline is not intended to store classified information.

The primary FedRAMP assessment boundary is the Stoke-operated Boltline SaaS production environment in AWS GovCloud (`prod-govcloud`).

SunStone Artemis Platform is SunStone's Federal Platform running on AWS GovCloud and Commercial AWS. The Apollo Digital Twin Engine can ingest and process OSCAL 1.1.3 models, prototype and extension models, markdown, and other document content to support agency AO and ISSO analysis workflows for CSO inventory, data flows, POA&Ms, incidents, threat models, testing exercises, change artifacts, impact assessments, deviation requests, and NIST 800-53 documentation.

SuperFile: Stay in control after you share. SuperFile helps organizations protect and share sensitive files while retaining control over access. Users can see who has access, manage sharing permissions, and revoke access after a file has been shared. Security controls are built into each file. SuperFile combines dynamic key generation, layered encryption, and embedded access controls with trusted device verification and decryption in memory. Files synchronize across devices, giving authorized users access wherever they work. Encrypted sharing and configurable settings let organizations determine who can open and share their content.

Sustainment Digital Manufacturing Hub (DMH) is a cloud-based supplier discovery and market research platform that helps government agencies identify, evaluate, and connect with qualified U.S. manufacturing suppliers. DMH provides AI-driven supplier intelligence, including capabilities data, certifications, machine and process information, and past performance context. Our platform enables acquisition teams, program offices, and sourcing specialists to conduct market research and strengthen the defense industrial base. DMH is the government enclave of the Sustainment platform, purpose-built for federal security and compliance requirements.

OpenFLIS is an easily customizable, FedRAMP Ready, cloud-based data collation, retrieval, and dissemination platform that enables users to search and display information across multiple databases, sources, and formats. When coupled with the Synergetics Craft Product Architecture (SCPA) application tool, OpenFLIS provides the ability to reach across technological generations and sources to provide access and visibility to any data in any format. The system consists of the SCPA collation and dissemination tool as well as provisioning, cataloging, search and discovery, Information Management / Knowledge Management (IM/KM), and administrator’s modules that comprise the platform.
